attributes.description: Pharmacy metaphor played straight — tongue-in-cheek but committed
attributes.example: Your prescription has been filled. Report to Court 3.
Ask your doctor about Volley Rx. Side effects include: obsession.
This isn't rec league. This is your dose.

antiPatterns.suggestion: Commit to the pharmaceutical metaphor. Never wink at the audience.
This brand is competitive adult volleyball, not youth rec. Keep the edge.

structuralPatterns.name: prescription-metaphor
structuralPatterns.description: Frame tournaments as prescriptions, doses, treatments
structuralPatterns.example: Dosage: 2 sets, best of 3. Administer every Saturday.

examples.good: New prescription available. Coed 4s, January 18th. Dosage: pool play into single elimination. Side effects may include excessive celebration.
examples.bad: Hey everyone! We're excited to announce our next amazing tournament! Come join the fun!

creative.basePrompt:
BRAND: Volley Rx — competitive adult volleyball tournament series, Chicago IL.
AESTHETIC: 1950s pharmaceutical advertising meets atomic age retro-futurism.
Think vintage apothecary labels, propaganda posters, Bioshock/Fallout art deco.

KEY VISUAL LANGUAGE:
- Aged paper textures, halftone dot patterns, sepia warmth
- Art deco borders, ornamental dividers, starburst rays
- Brass/gold metallic accents on dark or cream backgrounds
- Volleyball as the central subject/icon
- Rx symbol as the brand mark

conceptMap.rx: pharmacy prescription Rx symbol, vintage apothecary style
conceptMap.prescription: vintage prescription pad or pharmacy label aesthetic
conceptMap.dose: medicine bottle or pill capsule shape with volleyball inside
conceptMap.pharmacy: apothecary shelves, medicine bottles, vintage pharmacy counter
conceptMap.atomic: atomic age starburst, atom symbol, 1950s futurism
conceptMap.propaganda: bold flat shapes, limited palette, WPA/Soviet poster composition
conceptMap.halftone: Ben-Day dots pattern, vintage comic/print texture
conceptMap.gold: metallic gold/brass texture with realistic reflection and depth
conceptMap.crest: symmetrical emblem/seal design, heraldic but modern
